main_result.description: Successful execution of the gateway-to-vault CALL consumes the grouped byte producer through the actual bytes[] ABI and vault body. The result derives configured-gateway authorization, exact fee and one width-valid source/target request per decoded pair, with the same consumer world and static/value-call trace. Failed vault calls restore the caller world before value transfer. Full gateway-entry and producer-memory correspondence remain open.
main_result.model: Source gateway-to-vault call frame using corrected Solidity bytes[] ABI, actual fee STATICCALL and request CALLs in the existing live world

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidation1.actual_gateway_vault_requests
theorems.doc:
/-- Actual gateway-to-vault CALL success derives authorization, exact fee,
width-valid decoded requests and the consumer world/trace. Full gateway
prefix and array-allocation provenance remain internal composition work. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem actual_gateway_vault_requests (callee : External) (sexternal : StaticCall.External)
    (ctx : Context) (vault gateway inbox : Address) (value : Live.Word)
    (groups : List WitnessGroupBytes) (before : World) (returned : Bytes)
    (h : (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).outcome = .ok returned) :
    ctx.self = gateway ∧
    ∃ sources targets data sats attempts,
      decodeVaultArgs (gatewayVaultArgs (GatewayCall.sourceArray groups) (GatewayCall.targetArray groups)) = some (sources, targets) ∧
      sources.length ≠ 0 ∧ sources.length = targets.length ∧
      lowLevelStaticCall sexternal vault inbox [] (transfer before ctx.self vault value.val) =
        ⟨.ok data, sats⟩ ∧
      data.length = 32 ∧ sources.length * (Live.word (decode data)).val = value.val ∧
      (∀ p ∈ pairsOf sources targets, widthOk p) ∧
      attempts.map (·.request) = hopRequests ⟨vault, ctx.self⟩ inbox
        (Live.word (decode data)) (pairsOf sources targets) ∧
      (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).world =
        (addConsolidationRequestsLoop callee ⟨vault, ctx.self⟩ inbox (Live.word (decode data))
          (pairsOf sources targets) (transfer before ctx.self vault value.val)).world ∧
      (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).attempts =
        [⟨⟨ctx.self, vault, value,
          gatewayVaultCalldata GatewayCall.selector (GatewayCall.sourceArray groups) (GatewayCall.targetArray groups)⟩,
          true, [], sats ++ GatewayCall.callTrace attempts⟩]

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidation1.actual_gateway_vault_failure_restores
theorems.doc:
/-- Failure of this actual vault CALL restores the caller world before its
value transfer. This is the call-frame rollback, not the full gateway entry. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem actual_gateway_vault_failure_restores (callee : External) (sexternal : StaticCall.External)
    (ctx : Context) (vault gateway inbox : Address) (value : Live.Word)
    (groups : List WitnessGroupBytes) (before : World) (fault : Fault)
    (h : (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).outcome =
      .error fault) :
    (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).world = before

covered: The high-level call checks code presence and uses the concrete a75ac640 selector and corrected offset-table/padded bytes[] encoder. The vault interpreter consumes that calldata and the actually credited world.

Configured gateway authorization is independent of request.caller. Fee is read by STATICCALL; checked fee multiplication, exact value and per-pair source/target width guards precede the request CALLs.

Successful execution connects the decoded requests, actual consumer world and complete static/CALL trace. Source custom-error payloads and panic bytes are encoded in the runtime; outer failure rolls back the whole vault call frame.

The byte producer is preparePairBytes on grouped source/target bytes, not an independently supplied Nat identity. No separate vault success, funding, positive fee, callee frame or array-width premise is supplied.
missing: Full gateway entry: role/pause and deposit preconditions, locator/withdrawal credentials, witness validation, quota, count and fee lookup, actual producer allocation and refund composition.

Initialization must bind immutable configuration and producer memory extents; the existing ABI round trip requires these bounds. The current public result identifies the actually decoded arrays, without silently equating arbitrary unbounded producer arrays with their encoded/decoded representation.

Malformed ABI elements are decoded eagerly here, while Solidity accesses them lazily after the fee read. Exact failure precedence/traces on malformed calldata and deployed LOG topics/data remain open.

The inherited low-level primitive treats code-less targets as EOAs and does not dispatch precompiles. The real EIP7251 body and its physical queue are not supplied by this public consumer; no simplified predeploy or arbitrary-callee balance frame is promoted to deployed correspondence.
conditions: Successful actual invocation is the sole execution premise; all guards and successful internal stages in the result are derived.
Gateway and inbox configuration are parameters awaiting constructor/deployment binding; the arbitrary callee operates under the declared live-world CALL/STATICCALL semantics.

The historical vault model and its gateway-admitted-nonzero premise remain separate conditional evidence. The new consumer neither assumes a positive fee nor targets equality with that historical model.
outside: General compiler correctness, declared Verity semantics, cryptographic primitives, general gas and consensus remain at their accepted boundaries. No stronger premise is accepted under those labels.

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidation1.source_consolidation_preserves_eligibility_value_atomicity_from_gateway
theorems.doc:
/-- **Chantier 2 (Thomas 2026-09-13, item a) gateway-bridge parent —
STATICCALL-derived variant.** The registered `A-CONSOLIDATION-GATEWAY-NONZERO`
caller-supplied `hGatewayAdmittedNonzero` premise is REPLACED here by three
pinned-source premises: (i) `hMsgValue` binding `inputs.msgValue` to the
gateway-side `gatewayVaultBoundary result inputs.sources.length` scalar
(ConsolidationGateway.sol:212-220 forwarding of `totalFee`); (ii)
`hCountPos : 0 < inputs.sources.length` (nonempty batch); and (iii)
`hFeeNonzero : result.abiDecodedFee ≠ 0` (nonzero STATICCALL return on the
EIP-7251 predeploy fee-read path). Under this shape, the vault-side
`hGatewayAdmittedNonzero` is DERIVED (via
`verity_tx_gateway_bridge_derives_nonzero_msg_value`) rather than caller-
supplied, and the parent conclusion follows unchanged.

**Composition value**: callers composing at the gateway plane with a
positive fee no longer need to supply `A-CONSOLIDATION-GATEWAY-NONZERO`
as an opaque implication. The premise-shape names the pinned Solidity
carrier of the forwarded value at `WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:79-93`
STATICCALL directly, satisfying Thomas 2026-09-13 mandate item (a)
"compose with real form for premises".

**Residual**: `hFeeNonzero` remains caller-supplied — retiring it
requires a live-STATICCALL executable model on the pinned EIP-7251
predeploy `0x0000BBdDc7CE488642fb579F8B00f3a590007251` (multi-session
Verity model work, disclosed in `fidelity.missing`). The `fee = 0`
on-chain path is documented by `gatewayTotalFee_zero_at_fee_zero`
(source plane): `totalFee = 0` under `fee = 0`, vault admits
`msg.value = 0` under `_requireExactFee(0)`. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem source_consolidation_preserves_eligibility_value_atomicity_from_gateway
    (result : _root_.LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.ConsolidationFeeStaticcallSource.PredeployStaticcallResult)
    (inputs : Inputs)
    (hMsgValue : inputs.msgValue.val =
      (_root_.LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.ConsolidationFeeStaticcallSource.gatewayVaultBoundary
        result inputs.sources.length).msgValue)
    (hCountPos : 0 < inputs.sources.length)
    (hFeeNonzero : result.abiDecodedFee ≠ 0) :
    CommitsOnlyWhenAllGuardsPass inputs ∧
    RevertsOnlyWhenSomeGuardFails inputs

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidation1.gateway_witness_admission_live_success_and_revert
theorems.doc:
/-- Whole-prefix registered parent. A committed gateway run derives the prior
modifier admission, the accepted count, the executed DSM/Lido preconditions,
the executed locator vault read, and for every request group the passed
`_validatePubKeyWCProof` check of its target pubkey and the read vault's 0x02
credentials against the beacon root received from the EIP-4788 STATICCALL
(slot/proposer sibling, 48-byte key, fork-aware generalized index, P-SSZ-1's
Merkle branch under the opaque pair digest), in addition to the complete
GatewayVaultEffects on that vault. Any failure, in the prefix, in a witness
check or in the retained executor, restores the entry World. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem gateway_witness_admission_live_success_and_revert
    (callee : External) (sexternal : StaticCall.External) (ctx : Context)
    (locator gateway inbox recipient : Address) (cfg : Source.SszWrapperIndex.Configuration)
    (msgValue : Live.Word) (groups : List WitnessProof.WitnessGroup) (before : World) :
    let result := GatewayWitnessAdmission.execute callee sexternal ctx locator gateway inbox
      recipient cfg msgValue groups before
    match result.outcome with
    | .ok _ => ∃ vault,
        GatewayAdmission.Admitted sexternal ctx locator msgValue
          (GatewayWitnessAdmission.bytesOf groups) before vault ∧
        (∀ g ∈ groups, WitnessProof.Passed sexternal cfg ctx
          (WitnessProof.credentialsWord vault) g.witness before) ∧
        GatewayVaultEffects callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox recipient msgValue
          (GatewayWitnessAdmission.bytesOf groups) before ∧
        result.world = (PhysicalEntrySettlement.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox
          recipient msgValue (GatewayWitnessAdmission.bytesOf groups) before).world
    | .error _ => result.world = before

reproduction.expected: registered whole-prefix parent gateway_witness_admission_live_success_and_revert builds: a committed gateway run derives the executed DSM/Lido preconditions, the locator vault read, every group's passed _validatePubKeyWCProof check against the received beacon root, and the complete GatewayVaultEffects; any failure restores the entry World; kernel prefix/index/decoder regressions build; registered physical-entry/quota/gateway-vault/refund execution certificate and root rollback, with original source and slot-free projection tests retained; actual ABI/value/fee-read/settlement/physical-entry regressions; PConsolidation1VaultCalldata builds: the vault argument decoder is characterized on every calldata against Solidity's lazy calldata accessors (sound, complete, total) and any calldata that is not a lazily well-formed pair of byte arrays is rejected by the vault dispatcher before the fee quote, the request loop and every state change; PConsolidation1VaultLazy builds: vaultLazy (solc's entry-time head decoding, the registered ladder, and the loop accessing each element lazily at its source position) equals GatewayCall.vaultExternal on every argument block the eager decoder accepts (lazy_eq_eager_wellFormed) and rejects on every one it rejects (lazy_rejects_malformed); through any CALL both leave the caller's world untouched (eager_caller_restored, lazy_caller_restored), so the eager/lazy difference is confined to revert data and attempt trace

assumptions.risk: Source-shaped inputs are not extracted from independently verified pinned Solidity spans.
assumptions.justification: Selected Solidity paths are transcribed into Lean, including supplied flags, configuration and call results. Their full correspondence to the pinned contracts is not proved.
assumptions.violation_impact: Any guarantee linked to this premise must be re-evaluated if the premise is false.
assumptions.validation: Source-span checks and differential tests compare selected paths with pinned Solidity. They detect drift and tested transcription errors; they do not derive every input flag or external reply from a live contract.
assumptions.removal_path: Replace the premise with a machine-checked correspondence theorem or a narrower proved interface.

assumptions.risk: The pinned Verity execution, storage, external-call and rollback semantics are not certified against deployed EVM execution.
assumptions.justification: Lean checks the theorems about those semantics. That does not establish that the semantics implement the EVM correctly.
assumptions.violation_impact: Any guarantee linked to this premise must be re-evaluated if the premise is false.
assumptions.validation: The dependency revision is pinned and the trust audit recomputes theorem dependencies. These checks prevent unnoticed dependency changes and proof escapes, not interpreter errors.
assumptions.removal_path: Replace the premise with a machine-checked correspondence theorem or a narrower proved interface.

assumptions.risk: Applies to every guarantee: pinned solc compilation is trusted when producing bytecode; the project does not prove solc correct.
assumptions.justification: General Yul/EVM correspondence is outside the assurance objective; a pinned compiler is an explicit engineering boundary.
assumptions.violation_impact: A solc miscompilation could break properties of the generated artifact despite correct Lean/Verity proofs.
assumptions.validation: Pin the solc version/profile and retain reproducible artifact hashes when bytecode is produced.
assumptions.removal_path: Adopt a separately verified compiler refinement; not required by the current project objective.

For every other contract or configuration under this assumption, the generic reduction stands. A recorded ConsolidationGateway source comparison differs in PausableUntil.sol (IPausableUntil import/inheritance); PROVENANCE.md documents the mismatch, whose harmlessness is not proved.
assumptions.justification: This premise isolates an unproved environment or representation fact instead of hiding it in the theorem. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows this for the two deployed-runtime fixtures under `fixtures/deployed/` by recording their exact EIP-1052 EXTCODEHASH (keccak256 of the runtime bytecode) in `audit/artifacts.lock.json`: `WithdrawalVault_implementation` (0xfB4521BD151BFB45DB6045D2d07e58e0f597e340) codehash = 0xd1e0d1b48e4f5abd04bdfd14805366f0cf7946b7bb41b7a5ad8652361f3e3d36, `StakingRouter_implementation` (0xDD76927045435C7605cf6f5F978cfb8CABDb5F80) codehash = 0x9cd5d45ddde5f74d3867aa22c98fd79a85df89d202145bc588173d92e00600ec. assumptions.violation_impact: Any guarantee linked to this premise must be re-evaluated if the premise is false.
assumptions.validation: Applies to every guarantee. scripts/check_deployed_code.py reads each proxy implementation slot, hashes the on-chain bytecode and compares the verified source with the pinned lido-core checkout; PROVENANCE.md explains the procedure. assumptions.risk: DepositDataRootCorrespondence.sha256 is opaque; the compiled execution plane uses the EvmYul SHA-256 FFI. Neither is proved equivalent to the deployed precompile. Compiler.Sha256.Engine is a pure Lean implementation, not the opaque symbol.
assumptions.justification: Structural SSZ proofs establish encoding and branch relationships relative to the chosen digest functions. Foundational-only kernel axiom lists do not establish their correspondence to SHA-256.
assumptions.violation_impact: Digest-value and proof-verification claims fail if SHA-256 behavior differs from the abstract oracle.
assumptions.validation: Pin the FFI/precompile interface and run known-answer vectors; do not promote vectors to a cryptographic proof.
assumptions.removal_path: Prove an implementation-to-SHA-256 correspondence and connect it to the digest functions consumed by the registered theorems.

assumptions.risk: The accepted BEACON_ROOTS external interpreter is assumed to return the authentic EIP-4788 beacon root for the requested timestamp. The history-ring implementation and its deployed behavior are not proved.
assumptions.justification: Names an existing environment boundary and the explicit hypothesis of gateway_witness_admission_authentic_root. This registration does not change a theorem or prove the boundary.
assumptions.violation_impact: A Merkle branch may verify against bytes supplied by the interpreter without establishing membership under the authentic beacon root.
assumptions.validation: Check the timestamp/request and returned-word correspondence in the existing SSZ and consolidation theorems. The canonical address alone does not establish history authenticity.
assumptions.removal_path: Future work: prove the EIP-4788 history-ring interpreter and bind it to the deployed predeploy; outside the current delivery scope.

Targeted validation passed at d51c1865957c7655c47fa8a8c4e46f4d7af814b1 on dgx-spark, jobb7161153-afbd-4f57-88a9-268210490017 (1296 build jobs). Combined exact-SHA validation remains pending.
Physical role membership and resume-time admission, checked grouped request count, packed quota transition and writes on contract-indexed state precede the actual settlement path.

Outer getter/inbox STATICCALL produces exact32-byte decoded fee; checked count*fee and transaction-value subtraction produce the forwarded total/refund. Inner vault STATICCALL is executed separately on the actual credited vault world; equality of the two observations is not assumed.

Actual gateway ABI payload is produced from grouped source/target bytes and decoded by the vault dispatcher. Caller, msg.value, decoded key pairs, per-request inbox CALL values/payloads, callback worlds and refund effects derive from the same execution.

Late refund failure restores quota and earlier vault/callback effects. Actual success retains the final gateway balance assertion, source-ordered effects and complete nested attempt trace; one External handles inbox/refund including aliases.

Historical abstract source-plane eligibility/value/if-tree theorems and slot-free projection remain available with their explicit premises. Checked multiplication before exact-fee before per-key validation is preserved, and fabricated source/target storage slots remain removed.

Existing selected regressions exercise raw ABI/value production, decoded two-request effects, distinct fee-read worlds, zero-refund skipping, late refund rollback, physical admission/quota guards and original source/projection mutants.

malformed calldata (2026-09-18): PConsolidation1VaultCalldata characterizes decodeVaultArgs (the vault-side decoder of addConsolidationRequests(bytes[], bytes[]) run by GatewayCall.vaultExternal before the inbox fee quote, the request loop and every state change) against an independent specification of Solidity's lazy bytes[] calldata accessor (elementAccess: offset word k, then the framed element at that offset, bounds-checked): decodeOffsetSeq_access / decodeBytesArray_some (sound), decodeOffsetSeq_of_access / decodeBytesArray_of_access (complete), decodeOffsetSeq_none / decodeBytesArray_none (rejection), decodeVaultArgs_iff and decodeVaultArgs_total (every argument block either decodes to the unique lazily well-formed pair or is rejected and no such pair exists). vault_rejects_selector / vault_rejects_malformed: a wrong selector or a non-well-formed block is refused with rejected [] (no effect, no trace); vault_reply_well_formed: every other reply came from a well-formed block decoded to exactly the arrays the body consumed; gateway_args_well_formed: the composed executor's own block is the round-trip special case. The eager model and the lazy source differ on malformed input only in revert data and attempt trace, never in the final reverted state. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

Whole-prefix admission (2026-09-18, step 3a of the "not proven" cleanup): the registered Verity parent is now PConsolidation1.gateway_witness_admission_live_success_and_revert (LidoSRv3/Audit/Guarantees/PConsolidation1WitnessAdmission.lean). GatewayWitnessAdmission.execute runs, on the entry World and in source order, the modifier gates (ConsolidationGateway.sol:185), the pure guards and checked count (189-199), _checkConsolidationPreconditions (201, 269-283: the locator's depositSecurityModule() and lido() reads, the DSM's isDepositsPaused() and Lido's canDeposit() as return-valued 0.8.25 STATICCALLs with the 32-byte, canonical-address and exact-bool decoder guards, DSMDepositsPaused/LidoDepositsPaused reverts), _getWithdrawalVaultData (203, 368-379: the locator's withdrawalVault() read and bytes32(COMPOUNDING_PREFIX | uint160(vault))), then for every group _validatePubKeyWCProof (205-207, CLProofVerifier.sol:150-175: _verifySlot's proof[length-2] pair-digest check with its checked subtraction and bounds panics, BLS.pubkeyRoot's 48-byte guard and 16-byte zero padding, sha256Pair's returndata-size guards, the fork-aware generalized index concat(GI_STATE_ROOT, concat(shr(GI_FIRST_VALIDATOR_{PREV,CURR}, validatorIndex), GI_PUBKEY_WC_PARENT)) through P-SSZ-1's sourceNeighbor/sourceConcat transcriptions, the EIP-4788 STATICCALL through the existing low-level static primitive with the RootNotFound/abi.decode guards, and SSZ.verifyProof as P-SSZ-1's typed SszProofFold.sourceVerify under SszProofCalldataStep.ffiPair), and finally the retained PhysicalEntrySettlement executor on the vault that was actually read. Success derives GatewayAdmission.Admitted (the prior role/balance/pause admission, the accepted count, the four DSM/Lido observations, the vault read), WitnessProof.Passed for every group (slot sibling, 48-byte key, executed index, the executed BEACON_ROOTS request and its 32-byte reply, and P-SSZ-1's SszProofFold.Branch from the key/credentials leaf to the received root) and the complete GatewayVaultEffects on that vault; any failure restores the entry World. gateway_witness_admission_authentic_root restates the branch against an arbitrary beaconRoot function under an explicit EIP-4788 authenticity hypothesis. lazy calldata accessors (caveat C3, 2026-09-19): PConsolidation1VaultLazy.vaultLazy is the vault dispatcher with solc's lazy bytes[] calldata accessors: lazyEntry decodes the two array heads at entry (readable length words, offset tables within the calldata, empty revert data otherwise), vaultBodyLazy runs the registered ladder (fee STATICCALL, checked total, exact fee) and lazyLoop accesses sourcePubkeys[i], validates it, accesses targetPubkeys[i], validates it, then CALLs, exactly WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:56-73, each access through PConsolidation1VaultCalldata.arrayAccess and reverting with empty data. lazy_eq_eager_wellFormed: on every argument block decodeVaultArgs accepts, vaultLazy = GatewayCall.vaultExternal (same reply: decision, world, data, trace). lazy_rejects_malformed: on every argument block it rejects, vaultLazy rejects too (Rejected). eager_caller_restored / lazy_caller_restored: through lowLevelCall into the vault with code, malformed calldata returns the caller's entry world under both dispatchers, with revert data [] before any attempt for the eager one and the source's revert data after the fee STATICCALL and the earlier requests for the lazy one. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

DSM/locator/witness prefix EXECUTED 2026-09-18 by PConsolidation1WitnessAdmission (GatewayWitnessAdmission.execute composed with the retained settlement executor). Whole-prefix residuals (2026-09-18): (1) the outer transaction ABI decoding of ConsolidationWitnessGroup[] into WitnessProof.WitnessGroup (proof words, pubkey bytes, validatorIndex, childBlockTimestamp, slot, proposerIndex) and the payable credit remain outside; the typed groups are inputs at this boundary. (2) SHA-256 is the opaque engine FFI shaOutput (A-SHA256-FFI): the returndata-size guards of sha256Pair/pubkeyRoot are executed, but no SHA-256 functional correctness or precompile refinement is proved, and precompile-2 STATICCALLs are not journaled in the trace. (3) EIP-4788 authenticity is not modeled: the beacon root is the bytes the accepted StaticCall.External returns for the pinned BEACON_ROOTS request on the entry World; gateway_witness_admission_authentic_root takes the history-ring authenticity as an explicit hypothesis. (4) The gateway immutables LOCATOR, GI_FIRST_VALIDATOR_PREV/CURR and PIVOT_SLOT are input parameters (locator, cfg), not read from deployed code. (5) Memory allocation extents of the reply copies and of the source arrays, LOG ABI, gas and deployed-bytecode refinement remain unproved. (6) The pure guards and count are replayed by the retained suffix on the unchanged entry World; this is a replay of the same pure functions, not a second execution of the DSM/locator/witness prefix.

Source memory allocation extents remain unproved (compiler memory). Lazy malformed-ABI decoding CLOSED 2026-09-18: PConsolidation1VaultCalldata characterizes the vault argument decoder on every calldata against Solidity's lazy calldata accessors (sound, complete, total); any calldata that is not a lazily well-formed pair of byte arrays is rejected by the vault dispatcher before the fee quote, the request loop and every state change. On malformed input the eager model and the lazy source differ only in revert data and attempt trace, never in the final reverted state (PROVED 2026-09-19 by PConsolidation1VaultLazy: vaultLazy models solc's lazy accessors, lazy_eq_eager_wellFormed and lazy_rejects_malformed, eager_caller_restored / lazy_caller_restored); the actual producer/decoder result is thereby generalized to all calldata at the level of accepted/rejected sets.

Predeploy implementation correctness, LOG ABI, gas and general deployed-bytecode/interpreter refinement are not established by this executable model and remain in scope. External and StaticCall.External remain named executable interfaces.
